{"hypotheses": [

{"name": "Momentum-Duration", "mechanism": "Firms with high momentum and longer equity duration likely have significant growth opportunities, leading to higher risk-adjusted returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "EquityDuration"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60},

{"name": "Asset-Growth-Volatility", "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth and high idiosyncratic volatility are exposed to higher risk, commanding a risk premium.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},

{"name": "Quality-Investment", "mechanism": "Firms with high operating profitability and lower investment will have higher quality earnings, leading to higher returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},

{"name": "Value-Momentum", "mechanism": "Firms with high book-to-market ratios and positive momentum are undervalued and will earn higher returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Size", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

{"name": "Profitability-Illiquidity", "mechanism": "Firms with high profitability and illiquidity are undervalued and will earn higher returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Illiquidity"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},

{"name": "Momentum-Volatility", "mechanism": "Firms with high momentum and low idiosyncratic volatility offer a combination of high returns and low risk.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},

{"name": "Profitability-Asset Growth", "mechanism": "Firms with high profitability and low asset growth are undervalued and will earn higher returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65, "expected_decay_half_life_months": null},

{"name": "Momentum-ShareVolume", "mechanism": "Firms with high momentum and high share volume are underpriced and will earn higher returns.", "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "ShareVol"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}

]}
